## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Stop MCP SSE error reconnect loops (tool, ~3h, MODERATE)

- **What**: OpenCode #39697 stops MCP SSE error reconnect loops. When an SSE
  MCP server emits an error event (standard SSE protocol for server-side
  errors), the client was treating it as a transient connection failure and
  reconnecting immediately. For persistent errors (e.g. invalid configuration,
  missing credentials, unsupported operation), this created an infinite loop
  of connect-error-reconnect cycles, flooding logs and consuming resources.
  Now detects error events during SSE streams (event type `error` with data
  payload containing error details) and terminates the connection cleanly
  without triggering the reconnect logic. The connection is marked as failed
  with the error message surfaced to the user, and no automatic reconnect
  attempt is made. Transient network failures (TCP disconnect, timeout) still
  trigger reconnect with backoff.
- **Why**: Alexi has MCP v2 support (`src/mcp/client.ts`, `src/mcp/config.ts`
  with SSE transport, `@modelcontextprotocol/client@^2.0.0`). Applicable if
  Alexi's SSE MCP client has similar reconnect-on-error behavior (OpenCode's
  pattern is common in SSE client implementations that lack error event vs
  connection failure distinction). The pattern is generic: treating all SSE
  disconnects as transient failures leads to infinite loops when the error is
  permanent. Size: MODERATE (~3h: add SSE error event detection in MCP SSE
  transport handler, distinguish error events from network failures, terminate
  connection on error event without reconnect, surface error message to user,
  test error event handling lifecycle, verify transient network failures still
  trigger reconnect).
- **Source**: OpenCode PR #39697 "fix(opencode): stop MCP SSE error reconnect
  loops" (merged 2026-07-31T03:12:47Z, commit `8a7f9e3`). Full PR body at
  https://github.com/sst/opencode/pull/39697.
- **Category**: tool. **Size**: MODERATE (~3h: add SSE error event detection,
  terminate connection on error, prevent reconnect loop, test error event
  handling). **Status**: MODERATE signal (MCP SSE reconnect loop is a
  reliability/UX issue; Alexi has MCP v2 with SSE transport; applicable if
  SSE MCP client lacks error event vs network failure distinction).

#### 2. Parse stream error frames with zod and narrow retry heuristics (core, ~3h, MODERATE)

- **What**: Kilo #12700 parses stream error frames with zod, accepts null
  error fields, and narrows retry heuristics. Stream error parsing was
  fragile: `JSON.parse` followed by manual field checks (`error.error?.code`,
  `error.data?.error?.message`) that crashed on unexpected shapes. Now uses
  a zod schema covering multiple envelope shapes: top-level error object
  (`{ error: { code, message, details } }`), nested under data
  (`{ data: { error: { ... } } }`), and envelope-less shapes
  (`{ code, message, details }` directly at top level). Accepts null error
  fields (code/message/details can be null; zod schema uses `.nullable()`).
  Also narrows retry heuristics: previously any error containing "error" or
  "fail" triggered a retry; now matches only transient errors (socket hang
  up, ECONNRESET, ETIMEDOUT, ENOTFOUND, fetch failed, 502/503/429/rate limit).
  Non-transient errors (401/403 auth, 400/422 validation, model not found)
  are NOT retried.
- **Why**: Alexi has `src/core/streamingOrchestrator.ts` and
  `src/core/error-backoff.ts` for stream error handling and retry logic.
  Applicable if stream error parsing is fragile (manual field checks that
  crash on unexpected shapes) or retry heuristics are too broad (retrying
  auth/validation errors wastes budget and delays user feedback). The pattern
  is generic: streaming APIs from different providers return errors in
  inconsistent envelopes (SAP AI Core, Anthropic, OpenAI all have different
  SSE error shapes), and manual parsing breaks when a new provider is added.
  Size: MODERATE (~3h: add zod schema for stream error shapes covering
  multiple envelope variants, accept null fields in error object, narrow
  retry heuristics to transient-only patterns using regex on error message/
  code, test multiple error envelope shapes from different providers, verify
  non-transient errors are not retried).
- **Source**: Kilo PR #12700 "fix: surface provider error details from
  Responses API stream failures" (merged 2026-07-30T22:18:34Z, commit
  `3f7a9c8`). Full PR body at https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/12700.
- **Category**: core. **Size**: MODERATE (~3h: add zod schema for stream error
  shapes, accept null fields, narrow retry heuristics to transient-only
  patterns, test multiple error envelope shapes). **Status**: MODERATE signal
  (stream error parsing fragility is a reliability issue; Alexi has streaming
  orchestrator and error backoff; applicable if error parsing needs hardening
  or retry heuristics are too broad).
